canonical_project: Andorra Telecom Nexus (Santa Coloma) Data Centre
notes: CEEDA certification article names 'Nexus' among the three certified Andorra Telecom data centres (La Ciutat d'Andorra, 2025-05-27); CEO interview confirms three sites including Santa Coloma. Data Center Map places Andorra Telecom Nexus at Carrer Mossen Lluis Pujol 14, AD500 Santa Coloma (Andorra la Vella parish; aggregator detail C). Existence B; no public MW capacity.
